standard_prerequisites.use: Affine groupoid schemes, finite locally free maps, strict henselization and etale descent, finite invariant-ring quotients and stabilizers. The source-local integrality, invariant base change and point-orbit arguments are retained.

core_obligations: Use strict henselian localization and the retained invariant-ring/point results to split the etale groupoid morphism under its three Cartesian hypotheses.
Descend the local splitting to prove both etaleness of the invariant-ring map and the asserted Cartesian reconstruction ofU-prime.

proof_roadmap.step: Use strict henselian localization and the retained invariant-ring/point results to split the etale groupoid morphism under its three Cartesian hypotheses.

difficulty_reason: An etale map of atlases alone need not induce the stated quotient behaviour. The stabilizer-preserving and source/target Cartesian conditions must be combined through the local splitting argument, which supplies H2 work.

editorial_notes: Public299 treats inertia invariants of a finite abstract group acting on a ring. Here two finite-flat affine groupoids and a stabilizer-preserving morphism are given, and the conclusion includes a Cartesian atlas square.
Public1742 constructs an fppf invariant quotient for an equivalence relation; it does not establish this etale change theorem with stabilizers.
